questionText: Beynin yeni bilgileri hafızada tutma yeteneği, derin uyku evrelerinde gerçekleşen sinaptik budama süreçleriyle yakından ilişkilidir.
options: The brain's capacity to retain new information is intimately linked with synaptic pruning processes occurring during deep sleep stages.
Deep sleep stages directly determine how the human brain retains all incoming sensory data.

explanation: DOĞRU CEVAP: A. '...ile yakından ilişkilidir' yapısı 'is intimately linked with...' şeklinde birebir karşılanmıştır.

questionText:
The emergence of synthetic biology has blurred the historical demarcations between biological organisms and engineered machinery. Rather than merely modifying existing genetic sequences through traditional recombinant methods, synthetic biologists now design entirely novel genetic circuits from scratch, assembling bespoke DNA strands from chemical precursors. In clinical settings, re-engineered immune T-cells equipped with synthetic chimeric receptors have successfully targeted and eradicated refractory hematological malignancies that previously resisted aggressive chemotherapies. However, this profound capacity to fabricate living systems introduces serious biosecurity conundrums regarding dual-use technologies and unforeseen ecological consequences.

According to the passage, synthetic biology differs fundamentally from older genetic engineering because ----.
options: it constructs entirely novel genetic architectures rather than simply tweaking preexisting genomes
it operates without requiring any laboratory synthesis of chemical nucleotides
it has been applied exclusively to veterinary medicine without clinical human trials
it relies solely on natural evolutionary mutations without human intervention
it is incapable of producing effective therapeutics for hematological cancers
explanation: DOĞRU CEVAP: A. Metinde 'Rather than merely modifying existing genetic sequences... design entirely novel genetic circuits from scratch' denilerek eski yöntemlerden farkı açıkça belirtilmiştir.
